subject: POC / Trial: Success criteria & KPIs — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC / Trial: Success criteria & KPIs — next steps

Hi Aarti / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side to get the POC scoped and scheduled: 

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: Validate using Redwood for transaction classification + fraud triage enrichment in Atlas Payments' chargeback pipeline.
- Primary constraints: 25ms median latency target at 95th percentile SLA for single-request inference; peak throughput target ~1,200 reqs/min during busy windows; cost sensitivity ~<$0.002 per token; and maintain accuracy baseline so triage false positive rate does not increase >2%.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs for the POC (draft):
1) Latency: P95 <= 50ms, median <= 25ms for production-like input sizes (avg prompt length ~120 tokens).
2) Throughput: sustained 1,200 reqs/min with <1% error rate and <5% tail latency spikes.
3) Cost: estimated cost/token <= $0.002 (targeting batching/quantization to meet this).
4) Quality: classification F1 >= 0.88 on your labeled dev set; false positive rate delta <= +2% vs baseline.
5) Reliability: system can auto-fallback to a smaller model variant with <10% degradation in F1 during capacity events.

Next steps / owners:
- Atlas: confirm evaluation dataset (sample subset + labels) and representative load profile (Samir) — due Tue 5/14.
- Redwood: deliver POC plan + infra estimate and runbook (Jordan + Marissa) — due Mon 5/13.
- Redwood CS: assign trial owner and schedule kick-off demo/setup window (Marissa) — target week of 5/20.

I've attached a one-page POC plan and a sample load profile template to help. Please let me know if anything above looks off or if you want to add other KPIs (e.g., end-to-end latency including network hops).

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf

From: Aarti Shah <aarti@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC / Trial: Success criteria & KPIs — next steps

Thanks Jordan — very clear, and this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Dataset: we'll provide a labeled sample of ~5k transactions (anonymized) with the fields you requested. Samir will push this to the shared Drive link by Tue 5/14 COB.
- Latency: the P95 target listed is fine. For our integration we care about end-to-end processing (Redwood + app layer) staying under 100ms ideally. We can measure both service P95 and end-to-end.
- Throughput: 1,200 reqs/min is our target for peak sustained. We can do a phased ramp: start with 300/min in week 1 of testing, 600/min week 2, and target 1,200/min at week 3.
- Quality: our internal baseline F1 is 0.90 on the labeled set. We want to see no more than a 2% drop in F1. Could you also report precision/recall breakdowns and a small confusion matrix for top labels?

Samir will own load simulation and will coordinate with Ben for any request shaping we need.

Also cc'ing our security contact later in the thread for SOC 2 evidence; we'll need a short security questionnaire during procurement.

Appreciate the plan — looking forward to the POC docs.

Best,
Aarti
Director, Risk & Fraud
Atlas Payments

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti@atlas-payments.com>

Great — thanks for the confirmation and the phased ramp suggestion, that makes sense. A couple of additions and the timeline from our side: 

Deliverables / timeline: 
- Mon 5/13: Redwood POC plan + infra estimate (attached).
- Tue 5/14: Atlas delivers sample dataset + load profile.
- Wed 5/15: Kick-off call (30m) to review setup and agree on test harness and measurement tags; Redwood CS and infra engineers to join.
- Week of 5/20: Baseline runs at 300/min, initial quality eval and latency profile.
- Week of 5/27: Ramp to 600/min, run stability tests and measure cost/token estimates.
- Week of 6/03: Ramp to 1,200/min and finalize pass/fail against KPIs.

Ownership: Jordan (AE) + Marissa (CS) + Ben (Infra) on Redwood side. Samir (Atlas) owns load simulation and dataset delivery.

Metrics we'll capture from Redwood console: token-level latency distribution (P50/P95/P99), per-route throughput, per-request token counts, error rates, and cost breakdown by model variant. We'll also provide a short eval script to compute F1/precision/recall and confusion matrices for the labeled set.

Attached: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, sample-load-profile.csv

I'll set up the kickoff invite after we receive the dataset.

Thanks,
Jordan
